title: Rainbow Colors fifteen-shot new-pixel generation gate

plan.objective: Define the shot list, review sequence, and spend boundary for every Rainbow Colors shot that genuinely requires new pixels.
steps: Verify the authenticated MagicLight live balance before quoting or authorizing any generation.
Use locked Voxie canon and shot-purpose constraints for each prompt.
Generate one preview per authorized shot; do not batch-promote.
Run hard QC and request explicit approval before any lock or motion derivative.
Record task IDs, output hashes, cost, pre/post balance, and rejection history.

findings.message: No authenticated current MagicLight balance is available; general spend permission cannot authorize provider execution.
The complete new-pixel set is fixed and excludes shots with existing or review-candidate sources.

next_gate: Authenticate MagicLight, capture the live balance, and return a fresh per-shot quote before authorizing any preview.
